## Description {#details}

The file with the implementations of the µOS++ lists inlined methods.

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/inlines-h">inlines.h</Link></code> header file contains the C++ implementations of the inlined methods for the <b>µOS++ Intrusive Lists</b> classes, delivering an efficient and lightweight linked list management system tailored for embedded applications.

The class definitions are in the <Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-h">lists.h</Link> file.
